name: martial-arts-history-v1
description: A canonical FlakeGraph benchmark corpus about selected martial arts, combat sports, people, institutions, practices, and public events. The corpus treats martial arts history as a connected record of exchange and codification. It avoids claims that a single person exclusively founded a broad tradition and avoids unsupported direct-lineage claims.
